user_intent.summary: Take the best technical organs from ADV Elite Zero. Preserve [ ] as synchronized display/LED brightness control. Preserve L as a separate LED-only on/off control. LED brightness travel must stay aligned with display brightness travel.

rules: There is no independent LED brightness walk.
L never changes the display brightness.
L never changes the shared brightness index.
While LED is disabled, [ ] continue changing the shared brightness index.
When LED is re-enabled it returns at the current display brightness step.
Anomaly white must obey the shared brightness axis.
House amber must obey the shared brightness axis.
LED OFF is a hard physical-output gate and wins over state colors.

donor.name: JANUS CARDPUTER ADV ELITE ZERO v0.20 SKY ANCHOR
selected_organs: A9 Buzz worker with exact share target verification
A9 SD-first corpus with NVS fallback

integration_boundaries: Elite Zero is never a second ADV or cognitive authority.
J remains the manual LoRa ON/OFF gate.
Raw GNSS is trusted-swarm only by default; external/public paths redact it by default.
SHA256/SHA256d semantics, target comparison and verifier truth are immutable.
A9 may learn scheduling/search policy around SHA but never claim to learn or alter SHA itself.
Old SHA-home cognitive curriculum remains retired.
Prediction never overwrites observation and stale data is never treated as current.
acceptance_tests: Walk every [ ] brightness step and verify equal canonical brightness value is sent to display and enabled LED.
Disable LED with L, change brightness several steps, verify display changes while LED stays dark.
Re-enable LED with L and verify immediate restoration at the current shared brightness step.
Latch anomaly and House states at multiple brightness levels and verify color changes never bypass brightness scaling.
Reboot and verify shared brightness index and LED gate are restored by the final persistence layer.
epistemic_note: This checkpoint freezes architecture and transplant policy. Hardware behavior is only VERIFIED after the final ADV_Elite build is compiled, flashed and physically tested on the Cardputer ADV.
